assertions.rationale: Does not state client secrets are hashed and IdP properties unhashed/unencrypted in Duende Storage; recommends Data Protection encryption instead.

assertions.assertion: Recommends encrypted DB connections, encryption at rest, restricted DB access and protected backups
assertions.rationale: Does not recommend encrypted DB connections, encryption at rest or protected backups explicitly (only mentions backups as risk).

assertions.assertion: Advises not to grant direct read access to the configuration store as a substitute for an authorized admin API
assertions.rationale: Does not advise against direct DB read access as a substitute for an admin API.
